name: codex-bilibili-focus
description: Opens Bilibili while Codex works, then returns focus to the Codex desktop app.

interface.shortDescription: Open Bilibili during Codex runs and return focus when done.
interface.longDescription: A Windows helper plugin that lets Codex open Bilibili at the start of a turn and focus the Codex desktop app again before the final response.
defaultPrompt: Use Bilibili focus mode for this task.
Open Bilibili while you work, then return to Codex.
Start a Bilibili break and focus Codex when complete.
